# Art-is-Fun.com

> A comprehensive online art education platform offering step-by-step courses in color theory, alcohol markers, and creative techniques for all skill levels.

Art-is-Fun.com is founded by Thaneeya McArdle and provides structured online art courses through Teachable, focusing on practical skills like alcohol marker techniques and color theory fundamentals. The platform emphasizes beginner-friendly, accessible art education with hands-on lessons.
